g.text: Model comparison: cost and geometric benefit
Each dot is one LLM. Farther left means cheaper answers. Higher up means its suggestions separate the classes better.
GPT-5-mini is much cheaper than Opus and has a similar average gain here. The vertical lines show uncertainty in the
averages. These scores describe point layouts before retraining; they do not show better prediction accuracy.
